company.summary: MOWI ASA is a public limited company (allmennaksjeselskap) registered under produksjon av fisk, bløtdyr, krepsdyr og pigghuder i sjø og brakkvann (NACE 03.211), based in Bergen, founded 1992-05-18. Its verified website describes it as: “Mowi supplies sustainable seafood to over 70 countries, providing 9.7 million meals daily. Explore our products, investor relations, and global careers.” Public brand: Mowi Company Website. Registered activity: Produksjon, foredling, salg og distribusjon av sjømat og produkter som benyttes i sjømatproduksjon, enten direkte eller gjennom aksjeeie, deltakelse i andre selskaper og alt som dermed er forbundet. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue EUR 1.9 bn, operating result EUR 242.0 m, net result EUR 64.0 m, total assets EUR 7.1 bn, equity EUR 2.9 bn. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from EUR 1.9 bn to EUR 1.9 bn (-2%); net result went from EUR 194.0 m to EUR 64.0 m (-67%); equity went from EUR 2.9 bn to EUR 2.9 bn (-2%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin 12.8%; equity ratio 40.3%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 2884. Leadership in the official register: Ivan Vindheim (managing director); Leif Teksum (chair of the board); Peder Strand (board member); Lisbet Karin Nærø (board member); plus 13 further roles. 93 registered workplaces in Abelvær, Ansnes, Aukra, Averøy, Barstadvik, Bergen and more. Official website https://mowi.com/ (identity check: registry declared homepage); company-linked profiles on facebook, instagram, linkedin, vimeo. Latest company-published activity: “The Mowi Salmon Lifecycle” (2026-11-12). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
